titulo.alumno:
«Страдательное причастие прошедшего времени»
Past passive participle

intro: The past passive participle presents something as the object of an action already completed: написанное письмо, открытая выставка.

piezas.titulo: The past passive participle presents something as the object of an action already completed: написанное письмо, открытая выставка.
texto: The past passive participle presents something as the object of an action already completed: написанное письмо, открытая выставка.
The form agrees with the noun; the agent can appear in the instrumental if it is important to identify it.

frases.alumno: The document signed by the director has already been sent.

frases.estudio: В музее открыта выставка, подготовленная студентами.
frases.alumno: An exhibition prepared by the students is open at the museum.

opciones.explicacion: Письмо is neuter and takes написанное.
This form does not express the relation the question asks about.
Check which word governs the case or the structure.

pregunta.texto: What does this phrase mean? «Документ, подписанный директором, уже отправили.»

opciones.texto: The document signed by the director has already been sent.
opciones.explicacion: It corresponds to the first example.

opciones.texto: An exhibition prepared by the students is open at the museum.
opciones.explicacion: That is the translation of the second example.

frase.texto: В музее открыта выставка, подготовленная студентами

piezas.traduccion: An exhibition prepared by the students is open at the museum.
piezas.explicacion: Pay attention to the order of the words and to the grammatical form highlighted.
